# NONE32

NONE32 is a bilingual dental clinic in Zona Río, Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico. The clinic serves local patients and patients traveling from the United States, including San Diego and Southern California.

Address: Leona Vicario 1452, Interior 21B, Zona Río, Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico
Languages: English and Spanish

## Editorial principles

NONE32 treatment content is educational and procedure-focused. It explains expectations, limitations, material and biological considerations, treatment timing, maintenance, and why no two patients receive an identical plan. Treatment recommendations require an individual clinical examination and appropriate diagnostic records.

The clinic does not promise immediate loading, same-day teeth, graft-free treatment, or a specific outcome before clinical evaluation. For implant and full-arch treatment, anatomy, bone volume and quality, primary stability, restorative design, occlusion, habits, health history and the need for augmentation can alter the plan and timeline.

## U.S. patient information

NONE32 provides bilingual communication and can provide treatment documentation for eligible out-of-network reimbursement. Insurance coverage and reimbursement are determined by the patient's individual insurance plan.
